issues.title: MoE Top-K Training
issues.importance_rationale: Silent misconfiguration: the docs say the TopK MoE router is unsupported for training ('only used for inference/eval'), yet training configs with moe_router_type='topk' are accepted without any error or warning — users can burn large training runs on a router path that has no load-balancing loss, getting degenerate expert routing with no signal that anything is wrong.
issues.ownership_check: Unassigned; 0 comments since filing (2025-08-11, ~13.5 months); no claims, no maintainer response.
issues.platform_plan: CPU-only (Mac ARM64 or Linux CPU container): the fix and test live entirely in pure-Python config parsing. Unit test via NeoXArgs.from_dict/from_ymls with moe_num_experts>1 and moe_router_type='topk', assert calculate_derived raises/warns; run `pytest tests/unit/test_arguments.py`. The repo already runs these arg tests CPU-only (tests/unit/test_eval_loss_logging.py explicitly notes 'Avoid hardware discovery in NeoXArgs.calculate_derived during CPU unit tests'). No GPU, no training run needed.
